text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: And the one who conquered the Kikuka-sho is—!
(UWAAAAAH--!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Mission complete...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You ran your heart out, Bourbon!
That was the greatest Classic race ever!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for showing us
such great races throughout the Classic Triple Crown!

Faced with an outpouring of comforting words,
Mihono Bourbon showed a bewildered expression.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, I—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I failed to complete the Triple Crown.

She must have been quite bewildered, as Mihono Bourbon,
who usually prioritizes others' opinions, remained stubborn.
choice_data_list: Then let's see it through next time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Next," what do you mean?

Winning the Triple Crown wasn't the only dream they chased together.
Becoming an Umamusume who gives courage was another.
choice_data_list: We're running in the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.text:
A 3,200m long-distance GⅠ race... I'm sure the current
Mihono Bourbon can overcome it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I cannot be certain that such an act
will truly inspire 'courage' in people.

I prompt Mihono Bourbon to recall
how the crowd in the stands looked after the race.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Playing data log—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Uncertain if this qualifies as 'courage',
but I detect cheers, encouragement, and numerous positive emotions."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"I still cannot understand it.
I failed to achieve my original dream.
So why...?"
choice_data_list: Because there's real power in seeing you run.
Because there's power in the way you run.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
.............
Déjà vu phenomenon confirmed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Order... failed...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You ran your heart out, Bourbon!
You were so cool!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for showing us
such a great race!

Faced with an outpouring of comforting words,
Mihono Bourbon showed a bewildered expression.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, I—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I wished for victory.

She must have been deeply frustrated, as Mihono Bourbon,
who normally defers to others' opinions, remained stubborn.
choice_data_list: Then let's see it through next time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Next, you say?

Winning the Triple Crown wasn't the only dream they chased together.
Becoming an Umamusume who gives courage was another.
choice_data_list: We're running in the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.text:
A 3,200m long-distance GⅠ race... I'm sure the current
Mihono Bourbon can overcome it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I cannot be certain that such an act
will truly inspire 'courage' in people.

I prompt Mihono Bourbon to recall
how the crowd in the stands looked after the race.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Data log playback. ...Along with negative emotions,
I detect cheers, encouragement, and many positive emotions.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Incomprehensible. I did not win.
And yet, why...
choice_data_list: Because there's real power in seeing you run.
Because there's power in the way you run.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
.............
Déjà vu phenomenon confirmed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Just like at summer camp, I sense a strong "will" from Master.
...However, I am—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Whether this truly instills "courage" in people
or not is a judgment I cannot make.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, if it is Master's order, I shall accomplish it.
Therefore, I have accepted the second order.

And so, our next target race was set
for the Tenno Sho (Spring)!

—Just as we arrived at the academy,
Mihono Bourbon suddenly came to a halt.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ――! Unidentified error detected...
Mihono Bourbon pressed a hand against her chest looking bewildered, and closed her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, heading into the fourth corner of the Kikuka Sho,
Rice Shower is making her move!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(Her speed, her heat, her gaze, her breathing—
Rice-san's sheer spirit is...!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: (...Why now, in the middle of a race, am I interested in Rice-san—?)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Video footage of the Kikuka Sho automatically played.
Rice's figure came vividly to mind.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Along with it, a 'commotion' is detected deep in my chest.
What on earth... is this...?

Relieved to hear it isn't physical pain, but
I still have no idea what it could be.

Overwhelmed by her sheer intensity, it seemed an
uneasy, stirred-up feeling had welled up inside, but—

—Just then, the chatter of passing
high school girls caught our ears.

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see that!? This year's Kikuka Sho!
It was so close! Mihono Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
I saw it! That was so close!
Still, that was a fantastic run.

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Right. If they raced against Tokai Teio,
who would be stronger, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Tokai, Teio...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...? Resumption of "buzzing" confirmed.
choice_data_list: Could it be... you're curious about Teio?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No... I don't know...

With a bewildered expression,
Mihono Bourbon placed a hand over her chest.
choice_data_list: (To think she'd be paying attention to other Umamusume...)

text_block_list.text: Though they had been constantly compared to each other, she had never once paid any mind to Tokai Teio.

It wasn't just Tokai Teio.
Thinking of Rice Shower,
my heart was filled with unease.

The "unrest" born at the Kikuka Sho
might be a much bigger change than I thought.
I hope this doesn't have a bad influence on our next target race, the Tenno Sho (Spring)...
